method_input.plan_text:
Entities:
- A (resource): name = "A".
- B (resource): name = "B".
- S (resource): name = "S".
- E4: status = true.
Links:
- A → E4 (supports).
- B → E4 (supports).
- S → E4 (supports).
Link kinds: 'requires', 'supports', 'causes', 'blocks', 'enables' and 'derived_from' carry influence from the first entity to the second; 'informs' and 'references' do not carry influence. An 'influencing link into X' means one of the first kind ending at X.
Rules:
- Rules depend on these attributes of E4: status.
- status of E4 is true when at least one holds: (A exists with an influencing link into E4 and S exists with an influencing link into E4) OR (B exists with an influencing link into E4 and S exists with an influencing link into E4); otherwise false.
